Recipe.title: Recipe
Recipe.description: A cooking recipe with cover photo, structured ingredients, step-by-step instructions, category reference, frequency, and favorite flag.

description.description: Short description or introduction of the dish

coverImage.description: Public image URL for the dish (optional; falls back to default dish image when empty)

coverImagePath.description: Optional Firebase Storage object path used to delete or replace the uploaded image

ingredients.description: Ordered list of ingredient objects with name and quantity

cookingSteps.description: Ordered list of cooking step objects with step number and description

categoryId.description: Reference ID to a document in the categories collection (or empty string if uncategorized)

frequency.description: How often the dish is cooked

isFavorite.description: Whether the recipe is starred as a favorite

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the recipe was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the recipe was last updated

Category.title: Category
Category.description: A culinary category for organizing recipes.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the category was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the category was last updated

Note.title: Note
Note.description: A personal kitchen or cooking note.

content.description: Full text content of the note

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was last updated

/recipes/{recipeId}.description: Publicly readable recipes collection; create, update, and delete restricted strictly to verified Admin.

/categories/{categoryId}.description: Publicly readable recipe categories collection; create, update, and delete restricted strictly to verified Admin.

/notes/{noteId}.description: Publicly readable culinary notes collection; create, update, and delete restricted strictly to verified Admin.
